item.title: March 14: Celebrate Resiliency with Style at Annual Met Gala SCV
item.description: In this segment of SCVTV's Community Corner, we chat with Met Gala SCV Founder Eva Miranda-Crawford and her father and co-chair for the event Bill Miranda, as they give us a sneak preview of this year's meaningful celebration, which will include the very timely theme of Bridgerton meets steampark spark.

item.title: Tenth Annual ‘Many Families, One Community’ Family Resource Fair this March 21
item.description: The Sulphur Springs Union School District and William S. Hart Union High School District are back for the tenth annual 'Many Families, One Community' Family Resource Fair. This free event will host a multitude of important educational resources to help parents and their children succeed academically.
